notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for standard partial negotiated attribute-divestiture cancellation. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, multi-attribute FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies cancellation of one pending acquisition, confirmation and transfer of only the retained attribute, standard tags and callbacks, ownership state, and cleanup without asserting provider-specific behavior. Direct requirement mappings are limited to page-154-l27-8 -> §7.2 (evoked acquisition-tag echo), page-155-l173-48 -> §7.3 (evoked retained-attribute confirmation request), page-169-l24-3 -> §7.14.6 (owner cancels remaining negotiated offer), page-170-l13-1 -> §7.15 (one-attribute acquisition cancellation), and page-171-l52-13 -> §7.16 (one confirmation containing the canceled subset). Split-ownership and acquisition-delivery checks are public API observations without additional direct mappings. Current-source installed-package primary/contract passed 4/4 under both callback models; Java parity has official-API compilation only, not provider-runtime evidence.
